name: River Hill Fall 2022
information: This is a series competition with [Crystal City Fall 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CrystalCityFall2022). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Crystal City Fall 2022, your registration for this competition will be rejected. **COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION:** All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of a negative test for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. A rapid test is acceptable proof for a negative result. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, November 15th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. Along with a negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. Competitors and guests are *strongly recommended* to wear masks during the day to help prevent spread and protect themselves from COVID-19. Additionally, competitors are *strongly recommended* to bring at most one guest. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- This competition is supported by CubingUSA. ![](https://cubingusa.org/static/img/cubingUSA_4.svg)
